title: Resting oxygen consumption of an adult horse
source: Hanak J et al., A field study of oxygen consumption and estimated energy expenditure in the exercising horse, Acta Vet Brno 2001;70:133-139 (PDF text extracted). Other searches (Arabian endurance field study, Colombian Paso Fino, Standardbred treadmill) gave no resting mean that opened.
rows: Resting (standing) VO2, adult warmblood saddle horse
12 healthy warmblood saddle horses, age 4 to 12 y, mean body mass 477.5 +/- 32.8 kg; field, standing quietly 10 min in a respiratory mask before exercise
Table 1 gives 4.0 +/- 0.7 (caption: mean +/- S.E.M.; the Results text says SD). Low and high here are mean -/+ the stated 0.7 only, not a measured range.
